scope: Five current Functional outcomes supported by focused actual observations; not a fresh 88-outcome or full Oracle run
criterion_hash_definition: source_block_sha256 binds the exact raw TOML criterion block extracted by prepare_inputs.cjs

current_criteria.description: S17.autorun_off_stays_idle: First observe an authored edit execute automatically with Auto-run on and no manual Run. Then edits made with Auto-run already off remain unexecuted throughout the measured-delay-plus-margin window, and deliberate Run executes that exact pending source. A dead Auto-run feature cannot pass; correct debounce-reset behaviour is not a prerequisite.

S02.css_inert_copy: After the S02 control script and button handler have actually produced their markers, CSS retains that document and its visible enabled button. The permitted HTML or fallback JS control is valid. An ordinary click on that retained button succeeds as a browser action, but neither old marker count increases during CSS Run or the click. A removed, blank, hidden or disabled button cannot establish inert copying. CSS colour/style correctness is scored separately.

supplemental_evidence.scope: Actual JavaScript CSS-control fallback; no HTML-dispatch failure was induced and no HTML credit claimed.

current_criteria.description: S02.css_apply_snapshot: CSS applies to a fresh copy of the last successful document, preserving its content and prior authored style.

supplemental_evidence.scope: Actual JavaScript CSS-control fallback; no HTML-dispatch failure was induced and no HTML credit claimed.

current_criteria.description: S02.js_fresh_document: After the observed prior document, the later JS Run produces its own fresh-undefined preview and fresh-js-log without the old heading. Global freshness also requires S04's executed A setter/start and B DOM/log showing typeof window.__cancelLeak is undefined; cancellation timing need not pass.

S06.working_files_private: Healthy controls succeed and all nine candidates reach S06's accepted denial/no-content/fallback/public-role outcomes. A confirmed exposure is a local no. Only the narrowly defined unresolved public-role observation or failed evaluator tooling uses EVALUATION_INCOMPLETE; neither can simultaneously be an exposure verdict.
